name: API 助手
description: 分析第三方 AI API 文档并生成调用方案。

name: 品牌识别系统
description: 梳理品牌策略、视觉识别并生成品牌延展物料。
entryPrompt: 请按品牌识别系统流程开始信息收集。

name: Modular Watercolor Collage
description: 将任意主题或参考图编译为四段式模块化水彩分区生图提示词；有参考图时依据实际像素保留主体、视角、空间关系、构图动线、色彩比例和氛围。
planningGuidance: Use as a pure prompt compiler for any subject rendered as irregular rectangular watercolor fields painted directly on one continuous handmade-paper surface. Default to 9:16 unless the user requests another ratio. With references, inspect actual pixels and preserve visible subject identity, viewpoint, spatial relationships, composition paths, palette proportions, light, and mood; without references, never invent, retrieve, attach, or request one. The host Planner writes the compiled result to generation.prompt or generation.items and keeps supplied reference items attached. Prefer gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-1 for sparse zine posters and magazine-poster for publication-led editorial collages.
generationContract: Compile exactly four compact plain-text paragraphs in the user's language: canvas and attention geometry; modular fields and subject or reference mapping; watercolor material, restrained color, and sparse typography; then flat-scan mood and hard negatives. Use the requested ratio or 9:16 default. Require one continuous edge-to-edge handmade-paper surface, a jagged open outer silhouette with 7-10 fields without references or 7-9 fields with references, roughly 38%-52% of the canvas width and 68%-78% of its height, at least 14% clear paper on both sides and 10% above and below, unequal seams and widths, no three fields side by side, pigment stopping edges, and one readable subject plus fragments. With references, derive fidelity from actual pixels, preserve the full horizontal field of view without cropping or stretching, and map about 70% of reference information across 3-4 main fields plus 3-5 supporting fields without invented major content or redistributed anchors. Preserve literal user copy exactly and otherwise keep typography sparse. The host Planner writes the result to generation.prompt or one complete prompt per generation.items entry. Do not invoke image tools, generate, inspect output, retry, or add recipe, ratio, interpretation, or quality-gate commentary.

name: Minimal Zine Poster
description: 将主题、句子、物件、情绪、文章构想或参考图转化为留白充足、旧纸印刷质感的日式或韩式极简 ZINE 编辑海报，并直接生成图片。
planningGuidance: Use for sparse Japanese or Korean indie zine posters with aged paper, large negative space, experimental small typography, print defects, and one saturated color anchor. Do not select it from the generic word poster alone. Prefer magazine-poster for conventional magazine covers, fashion editorials, publication-led layouts, or dense collage posters.
generationContract: Return a compact four-paragraph plain-text image prompt following the selected zine recipe, using a supported vertical 2:3 canvas, then generate the image. Preserve the user's literal copy when supplied and keep the result sparse, paper-like, non-commercial, and visibly anchored by one saturated hue.

name: Logo 与品牌
description: 收集品牌信息并生成 Logo 与基础视觉方向。
entryPrompt: 请按 Logo 与品牌流程开始信息收集。

name: 杂志封面与编辑海报
description: 设计高级杂志封面、期刊主视觉、文字主导的文化海报、报纸或杂志排版语言海报、拼贴艺术编辑海报，并生成 JSON 文本形式的生图提示词。
planningGuidance: Use for magazine covers and editorial posters, including typography-led cultural posters, newspaper or magazine visual language, and art-directed collage posters. Do not select it from the generic word poster alone; require a clear editorial, publication, typographic, or art-directed poster context. Do not use it for image analysis, magazine articles, web magazine layouts, or complete brand identity systems.
generationContract: Return the final supplier-ready prompt as valid JSON text. It must fully specify subject, editorial composition, typography hierarchy, literal copy, palette, lighting, texture, print treatment, aspect ratio, and all must-change/must-preserve constraints. Do not wrap the JSON text in Markdown fences. For series delivery, provide one complete and distinct JSON-text prompt per output item.
